snippet.title: DeadShore // Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Play the Game ► https://store.steampowered.com/app/3805860/DeadShore/

Deadshore is an VR wave based Island survival filled with the undead. The strategy you pick will be the deciding factor in how long you survive. Pick your weapon of choice and see how long you can survive

Developed by
NotGass
